Title: Checkout is allowed with an empty cart
Preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user; the cart is empty (no badge on the cart icon)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com and log in as standard_user
2. Confirm the cart is empty
3. Click the cart icon
4. Click 'Checkout'
5. Note which page opens
Expected Result: Checkout is blocked, or the user is warned that the cart is empty.
Actual Result: The checkout form opens (/checkout-step-one.html, 'Checkout: Your Information') even though the cart is empty.

Title: Product buttons still show 'Remove' after Reset App State until the page is refreshed
Preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user; 2 items have been added to the cart
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Click the menu icon
2. Click 'Reset App State'
3. Without refreshing, look at the buttons on the product cards
4. Press F5 and look at the buttons again
Expected Result: The buttons for the items that were in the cart return to 'Add to cart'.
Actual Result: The cart badge clears, but the buttons still read 'Remove'. They return to 'Add to cart' only after a normal page refresh (F5).
